evals.prompt: Using Pontx, retrieve the latest monthly ECB USD/EUR observation for a TypeScript service. Show the safe request first.
evals.expected_output: Discovers the live Pontx contract, confirms DSD order, previews a one-observation bounded request, distinguishes preview from direct execution, and avoids calling the value real-time.

evals.prompt: Design an incremental importer for one ECB dataset that survives revisions, deletions, and partial failures.
evals.expected_output: Uses a bounded backfill and successful checkpoint, applies updated additions/revisions/deletions atomically, and does not invent pagination.

evals.prompt: Explain how to check whether portal code EXR.D.USD+JPY.EUR.SP00.A exists without downloading observations.
evals.expected_output: Splits flowRef from the DSD-ordered key, validates codes, uses the series-only availability mode, and interprets no match narrowly.
